title: Parity of a uniform binary inner product
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb{N}$, choose $u,v$ independently and uniformly from $\mathbb{F}_2^m$. The probability that their dot product in $\mathbb{F}_2$ equals $1$ is $\frac{1-2^{-m}}{2}$.
